notes.text:
Finally, I can offer a visual tracker for Anno 1800 courtesy of Universal Tracker!

### Changes
* Added support for Universal Tracker to the Anno 1800 client
  * If UT is installed and a fitting config .yaml is present, the client will automatically add tracking tabs, one of which has a nice visual overview
  * Tracking is fully logic-compliant
* Reworked the client, so that you can connect to the AP server at any time - this allows checking the tracker before connecting to Anno 1800
* Removed 1500 obreros from the victory condition of the default and full presets due to redundancy
* Updated to Archipelago 0.6.8
* Revamped setup guide for better readability
* Fixed Anno 1800 not connecting to the client when the mod folder was renamed
* Fixed Anno GUIDs counting further and further up when more than 1 slot in a multiworld was Anno
* Fixed random skyscraper hints when receiving regular residences
  * Unfortunately, this also removes the proper skyscraper hints on reaching engineers or investors
* Fixed the mod not showing up for download when hosting a game on the website

This release is compatible with version 1.4.0 onwards. That means you can use this to have a tracker in your existing games!
